description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Magistrate demo, steps 4 and 6): get the Magistrate's ruling on your referral, recorded on your copy with a ruling receipt id once a Magistrate seated for it (O-VESTED-MAGISTRATE) has decided; while it is being heard it reports IN_HEARING, and if no Magistrate is connected it reports DEEP_REVIEW_PENDING ('Demonstration result, not decided by any Magistrate'). No ruling is written in advance. The Magistrate reads both sides and writes its own ruling. Not certified; binds only your practice copy. Pass verify_text (and optionally receipt_id) to check a copy of the ruling text against the stored ruling (whole text compared).

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
